Description: Delegate real work to Copilot, such as creating or updating records or running actions in Business Central.
GettingStartedSteps: Use a US, GB, or DE Business Central online early access preview sandbox on version 30.0.56564.0 or later with a Partner Sandbox license and evaluation data only.
Ensure your tenant has an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription, Copilot Chat is enabled in Business Central, and you have a valid Business Central license and Microsoft Copilot access.
Open your evaluation company in Business Central, then open Copilot Chat. Copilot works in the current company and environment.
Note a demo customer's original phone number, then ask Copilot in English to change only that field to a test number, identifying the customer by number. Changes are saved immediately.
Inspect Copilot's action log and the customer record to verify only the requested change, then restore the original phone number.
Optionally use Send feedback in the Chat menu or the thumbs-up or thumbs-down controls to share feedback.
